answer: One enforceable rule: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The saffron of work and the willow of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a grove to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
